restriction: Strict native comparisons require stripped symbols; keep is refused because debug paths are not reproducible across output directories.
scope: Frozen flattened whole-program inputs, old Canonical/Dense controls, current flat TS control and compiled A0 frontend. Parser/checker plus one historical C text emitter. Frontend instantiation/upload/typed-IR decoding included. Graph I/O, shipping CLI startup, formatter, model inference and generated-target execution excluded. Every fresh process preloads the common candidate SDK and its selected artifact; candidate artifact also preloaded for historical and TS controls. Per-sample preload records identify every Wasm component, hash and size. Artifact validation and Wasm module compilation are outside frontend/pipeline phases; fresh-child wall time includes process startup and preparation. No official source cutover or no-regression conclusion is implied.
protocol: Reuse the archived frontend experiment input corpus and rotated fresh-process protocol; one discarded warmup round and seven measured rounds. Every arm uses the historical baseline C text emitter, so frontend IR is compared through one fixed backend even when frontend artifact code generation changes. Every emitted C hash must match the baseline control. That control must match the frozen reference after the explicitly recorded compiler-version banner substitution. Compiler-codegen mode requires two freshly recorded C-derived artifacts: identical A0 source closure/count, ABI, runtime, libraries, Clang/LLD and compiler build versions, frontend emission options and complete normalized compile/link flags. Both artifacts reproduce exact C through their own fresh compilers; complete compiler inventories and all differing inputs are recorded. Legacy manifests are ineligible.
